struct.name: GPCR_S
struct.from: shipped IRIX kernel binaries, per docs/nic.md
struct.doc: The I/O controller's general-purpose control word, written through its set alias. Before reading the address part the routine stores 0x200000 to the register address its caller passes, when that address is not null; with a null address it prints that it is bypassing the enable and goes on. The word is written whole, so bit 21 is the only bit the routine sets. That the store enables the one-wire path to the part is read from the routine's own message, and that a set alias leaves other bits alone is inferred from its name.
